L // This implementation chooses between local storage and remote storage for   //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // the contained target object based on the target object's size, alignment   //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // requirements, and whether or not it has a nothrow move constructor.        //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // Additional optimizations are performed when the object is a trivially      //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // copyable type [basic.types].                                               //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // There are three datamembers per `AnyInvocable` instance                    //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // 1) A union containing either                                               //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //        - A pointer to the target object referred to via a void*, or        //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //        - the target object, emplaced into a raw char buffer                //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // 2) A function pointer to a "manager" function operation that takes a       //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //    discriminator and logically branches to either perform a move operation //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //    or destroy operation based on that discriminator.                       //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // 3) A function pointer to an "invoker" function operation that invokes the  //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //    target object, directly returning the result.                           //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // When in the logically empty state, the manager function is an empty        //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // function and the invoker function is one that would be undefined behavior  //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // to call.                                                                   //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L //                                                                            //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // An additional optimization is performed when converting from one           //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // AnyInvocable to another where only the noexcept specification and/or the   //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // cv/ref qualifiers of the function type differ. In these cases, the         //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // conversion works by "moving the guts", similar to if they were the same    //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // exact type, as opposed to having to perform an additional layer of         //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
T 80 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp
L // wrapping through remote storage.                                           //
T 2 source.cpp comment.line.double-slash.cpp punctuation.definition.comment.cpp
